title: Enumerating Posterior-Supported Priors: First-Order Error of Finite-Integral Cross-Categorical Measurement Morphisms
abstract: arXiv:2611.17390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In generative modeling, standard measure theory adopts the a.e. convention, which legitimately ignores any error component carried by a null-support set: a single null element can hide out-of-domain error inside null support and never be explicitly accounted for. The contribution of this paper is not a new distributional distance, but rather a verifiable structure that writes down which underlying predicate supports a high-level object, when it is invertible, and at which layer the error resides, from which we propose the enumerating posterior-supported prior framework. translated_title: 枚举后验支撑先验：有限积分跨范畴测量态射的一阶误差
translated_abstract: 在生成建模中，标准测度论采用几乎处处（a.e.）约定，这合理地忽略了由零测度支撑集所携带的任何误差分量：单个零测度元素可以将域外误差隐藏于零支撑内部，而永远不会被显式计入。本文的贡献不是提出一种新的分布距离，而是一种可验证的结构，该结构明确写出了哪个底层谓词支撑着高层对象、它在何时可逆、以及误差驻留在哪一层，由此我们提出了枚举后验支撑先验框架。该框架运行于三层范畴链 Quot->MorTop->Set 之上：前两层不假设任何点元素，并以二元谓词商划分作为对象；副本索引计数测度将一对多集合依次区分为单射，把对象收集从满射提升为商层双射；互斥……
tldr: 提出枚举后验支撑先验框架，基于 Quot->MorTop->Set 三层范畴链显式记录底层谓词支撑、可逆性与误差所在层级，解决标准测度论 a.e. 约定下零测度支撑隐藏域外误差无法被显式计入的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an enumerating posterior-supported prior framework built on a three-layer categorical chain (Quot->MorTop->Set) that explicitly records which underlying predicate supports a high-level object, when it is invertible, and at which layer the error resides, addressing out-of-domain errors hidden in null supports under the standard a.e. convention of measure theory.
